baseline: fresh post-health backup; original T0 not substituted
install: once install exact old-C7 backup78, dual signature verify before/after, rediscover paths; no uninstall/build/redeploy
AppGroup: unchanged; verify only, no application restoration planned
system_snapshots: 4 path renames; content SHA multiset equal; retain current system paths
metadata: preserve current/new container root UUID/system metadata; classify added provenance, no all-metadata equality claim
stop: new unlisted install/data differences, running target processes, source/backup drift or restoration readback mismatch; no force/cleanup/redeploy
exit: old78 byte/signature match; main except system snapshot rename/root metadata matches fresh backup; AppGroup remains matching; diagnostic keys original absent and deployment original booleans; runtime health separate
